title: PolicyPerformance
description: ION Finance Insurance Performance Extension v1 — policy coverage period tracking placed in Contract.performance[].performanceAttributes.

coveragePeriodStart.description: Date from which coverage is in force.

nextRenewalDueDate.description: Date by which renewal must be confirmed (typically coveragePeriodEnd − 30 days).

claimCount.description: Total number of claims filed during this policy period.

ncdPercentage.description: No Claims Discount percentage earned (0–25%). Applied at renewal.

remainingSumInsuredIDR.description: Remaining sum insured after partial claims. Full IDV for no-claim policies.
